process.heading: Buy / Sell New or Used Cars
process.subtitle: Under New and Used Vehicles: search by need/budget, contact seller, verify yourself. Auto saving after eligible purchase.

0.title: Find a car
0.text: Search for a new or used car according to your needs and budget on the company platform.

1.title: View listing details
1.text: Review model, year, condition, estimated price, photos, location and registration related details where available.

2.title: Contact the seller
2.text: Contact the seller or a company representative regarding the car you are interested in.

3.title: Inspect & complete
3.text: Personally inspect vehicle and papers, agree price, then complete purchase according to legal requirements.

buySell.buyerText: Find → view info → contact → inspect engine, body, documents & registration → finalize price → complete legal purchase.

scope.heading: Marketplace + Auto Saving
scope.marketplaceText: Buy and sell new or used cars on an organized platform with listing details and personal verification before the deal.
scope.autoSavingText: After an eligible vehicle purchase through the company system, designated amount may enter automatic saving and lucky draw.
scope.carPlanText: Car Saving has no separate installment booklet. Installment value tiers belong to Car Plan a different program.

disclaimer.title: Important Clarification
disclaimer.text: Buyers are responsible for personally verifying the vehicle’s condition, ownership, registration and documents before purchasing. Information on the platform is not final legal proof of ownership. All transactions follow relevant laws and company terms. Car Saving here is marketplace + auto saving not a duplicate of the Car Plan installment booklet.
